doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR2: Players can interact with events by pressing E or clicking when near an event object. FR6: Players can resolve events by reaching the event location and interacting with it before the timer expires. Interaction: Press E key or click on event indicator when character is near event location. Interaction range should be configurable (e.g., 50-100px distance).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR24: The game supports at least 4 event types: low phone battery, boiling kettle, candle needed/going out, cat stressed. FR25: Each event type has specific interaction requirements (e.g., plug phone into power bank, turn off kettle, light candle, calm cat). FR26: Events have different scoring values: minor events (+10 points), standard events (+15 points), critical events (+20 points). FR27: Events have different «Затишок» impacts: minor events (+5/-5), standard events (+8/-10), critical events (+10/-20).

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Event UX: Players interact with events by pressing E key or clicking on event indicator. Interaction range should be clear (visual indicator when in range, optional). Visual feedback on interaction: Event icon briefly pops/scales up and fades out, Floating text appears above event location showing points and coziness gain, Small particle effect (optional, CSS animation). Interaction should feel immediate and responsive (within 1-2 frames).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.section: Game Event System Pattern, Communication Patterns
doc.snippet: Game Event System Pattern: EventManager.resolveEvent() method exists and handles event removal. EventManager.resolveEvent(eventId: string, activeEvents: GameEvent[], removeEventCallback: RemoveEventCallback): GameEvent | null. Returns event data for score/coziness calculation, or null if event not found. Communication Patterns: Keyboard input handling uses useEffect for event listeners. Listen for keydown/keyup events. Track which keys are currently pressed. Clean up event listeners on component unmount. Use React Context for state updates (setScore, setCoziness, removeEvent).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Project Structure: Character component at src/components/game/Character.tsx. EventIndicator component at src/components/game/EventIndicator.tsx. EventManager at src/core/EventManager.ts. GameContext at src/contexts/GameContext.tsx. Constants at src/utils/constants.ts. Utility functions in src/utils/ directory (e.g., distance calculation utility).

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 2.9 focuses on implementing player interaction with events. Players can interact with events by pressing E key or clicking when near them. Interaction detection checks if character is within interaction range (50-100px). Interaction triggers EventManager.resolveEvent() to remove event and update game state (score, coziness). Interaction is prevented if character too far, event expired, game paused, or game over. Visual feedback will be implemented in Story 4.6. Achievement progress checks will be implemented in Story 3.5.

doc.title: Story 2.8: Event Timer Display
doc.snippet: EventIndicator component fully implemented. Component displays event icons with priority colors and circular timer ring. Component receives event object with timer, location, and all event properties. Component structure is solid, can add onClick handler for mouse interaction. Component uses CSS Modules for styling (EventIndicator.module.css). EventManager.updateEvents() updates timers every frame. Event timers decrement by deltaTime every frame. Expired events (timer <= 0) should prevent interaction.

doc.title: Story 2.3: Character Visual and Movement System
doc.snippet: Character component stores position in state as { x: number, y: number }. Position updated every frame via movement. Position constrained to apartment boundaries. Character component handles keyboard input using useEffect for keyboard event listeners. Listens for keydown/keyup events. Tracks which keys are currently pressed. Can add E key handler to existing keyboard input system.

All update functions use functional updates to avoid stale closures.

On E key press, find nearest event within interaction range. If event found, trigger interaction. Handle multiple events (select nearest or first found). Reference architecture document for input handling patterns.

Add onClick handler to EventIndicator component. Handler should check character distance before allowing interaction. Prevent default click behavior if needed. On click, check if character is within interaction range. If within range, trigger interaction. Prevent interaction if character too far. Reference Story 2.7 for EventIndicator component structure.

Check character distance before allowing interaction (use isWithinInteractionRange). Check if event has expired (timer <= 0) before allowing interaction. Check if game is paused (isPaused === true) before allowing interaction. Check if game is over (gameOver === true) before allowing interaction. Return early if any prevention condition is met. Reference GameContext for game state flags.

Call EventManager.resolveEvent(eventId, activeEvents, removeEvent) to resolve event. Handle null return (event not found). Extract event data from resolved event (points, cozinessReward). Update score: setScore(prev => prev + resolvedEvent.points). Update coziness: setCoziness(prev => prev + resolvedEvent.cozinessReward). Use functional updates to avoid stale closures. Event removal handled by EventManager.resolveEvent() via removeEvent callback.

Add interaction lock flag or debounce mechanism to prevent multiple simultaneous interactions. Only one event can be interacted with at a time. Release lock after interaction completes. Test with rapid key presses or clicks. Can use useState or useRef for lock flag.

Character component: Provides character position for distance calculation. EventIndicator component: Provides click handler for mouse interaction. EventManager: Provides resolveEvent() method for event resolution. GameContext: Provides state update functions (setScore, setCoziness, removeEvent) and game state flags (isPaused, gameOver). Game loop: May need to check for keyboard input (E key) in game loop hook. Visual feedback: Will be implemented in Story 4.6 (prepare data for feedback). Achievement checks: Will be implemented in Story 3.5 (prepare for achievement tracking).

tests.standards: Testing should focus on interaction functionality and integration testing. No formal test framework is currently set up, but manual testing should verify: Keyboard interaction (E key) with character near/far from events, Mouse interaction (click) with character near/far from events, Interaction prevention when game paused/over/event expired, Score and coziness updates on successful interaction, Event removal on successful interaction, Only one event can be interacted with at a time, Interaction with multiple events (select nearest), Interaction range accuracy (50-100px). Distance calculation should be tested with various positions.
tests.locations: Manual testing in browser during development. Visual verification of interaction feedback. Performance testing using Chrome DevTools Performance tab. No automated test files exist yet - consider adding tests in src/components/game/Character.test.tsx and src/components/game/EventIndicator.test.tsx if test framework is added.

test.idea: Test keyboard interaction (E key) with character near event: Event is removed from active events, Score increases by event's point value, «Затишок» increases by event's coziness reward. Test mouse interaction (click) with character near event: Same verification as keyboard. Test visual feedback is prepared (Story 4.6 will implement). Verify EventManager.resolveEvent() is called correctly. Verify game state updates are functional (no stale closures).

Test interaction detection checks character distance: Character within range (50-100px) allows interaction, Character outside range prevents interaction. Test interaction range is configurable (INTERACTION_RANGE constant). Test keyboard interaction (E key) works when character near event. Test mouse interaction (click) works when character near event. Test only one event can be interacted with at a time (interaction lock). Test interaction with multiple events (select nearest). Test distance calculation accuracy with various positions.

Test interaction prevention when character too far from event: Interaction is blocked, No event resolution occurs. Test interaction prevention when event expired (timer <= 0): Interaction is blocked, No event resolution occurs. Test interaction prevention when game paused (isPaused === true): Interaction is blocked, No event resolution occurs. Test interaction prevention when game over (gameOver === true): Interaction is blocked, No event resolution occurs. Test all prevention conditions work correctly.

Test interaction triggers EventManager.resolveEvent(): Method is called with correct parameters, Event is removed from active events, Event data is returned correctly. Test score updates on successful interaction: setScore(prev => prev + points) is called, Score increases by correct amount. Test coziness updates on successful interaction: setCoziness(prev => prev + reward) is called, Coziness increases by correct amount. Test achievement progress checks are prepared (Story 3.5 will implement). Test visual feedback animations are prepared (Story 4.6 will implement).

Test distance calculation utility function: Calculate distance between character and event positions, Use Euclidean distance formula: sqrt((x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²), Test with various positions (near, far, diagonal), Test with edge cases (same position, very far positions), Test isWithinInteractionRange() returns true when distance <= range, Test isWithinInteractionRange() returns false when distance > range.

Test E key event listener: Listener is set up in Character component or game loop, Listener responds to 'e' or 'E' key press, Listener is cleaned up on component unmount, Listener finds nearest event within interaction range, Listener triggers interaction when event found, Listener handles multiple events (selects nearest).

Test onClick handler on EventIndicator: Handler is added to EventIndicator component, Handler checks character distance before allowing interaction, Handler triggers interaction when character within range, Handler prevents interaction when character too far, Handler works correctly with multiple events.

Test Character component integration: Character position is available for distance calculation, E key handler integrates with existing keyboard input system, Character position updates correctly during movement. Test EventIndicator component integration: onClick handler integrates with existing component structure, Handler receives correct event data, Handler checks character distance correctly. Test EventManager integration: resolveEvent() is called with correct parameters, Event removal works correctly, Event data is returned correctly. Test GameContext integration: setScore() updates score correctly, setCoziness() updates coziness correctly, removeEvent() removes event correctly, gameState flags (isPaused, gameOver) are checked correctly.

Test interaction system performance: Distance calculations are efficient, No performance impact on game loop (60 FPS maintained), Interaction handlers don't cause frame drops, Rapid key presses or clicks are handled correctly, Interaction lock prevents performance issues from multiple simultaneous interactions.
